purpose: Every link between RealityEngine entities, its protocol, its transport status today and the issue that brings it to the profile (RealityEngine_CI#668, #725). status: plaintext | tls (encrypted, profile compliance not yet verified) | compliant (verified against the profile by the probe stage, #728) | unverified (not yet checked). mtls is true only when the probe has verified both ends present install-CA certificates. A link may carry a `deficiency` only by owner decision: what falls short of the profile, what compensates, the remedy, and `allows`, the exact status or mtls value it permits. The release gate reports such a link instead of failing on it, within what `allows` permits. audience: service (default; mTLS) | user (a person's browser or device) | external (an outside party); user-facing and external links expose TLS only and need no client certificate, but plaintext or an unverified link on them fails the release gate unless an owner deficiency records it (owner, 2026-11-12).

deficiency.what: Grafana's own listener is Go: it also accepts TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, and takes no client certificate.
deficiency.compensation: Reachable only inside its own network namespace (127.0.0.1), and only by its front, which offers the profile's suites alone and verifies it against the lane CA; the front requires the lane client certificate of every caller.
deficiency.remedy: Go adds TLS 1.3 suite configuration; then the service serves its port itself and the front is removed.
probeAccepts: a suite outside the profile accepted
